name: loadout-list
description: Regression spec for /loadout: opens the loadout picker (LoadoutListAltView) and returns cleanly to the input prompt on Esc.

config.command: bash -lc 'R=$(pwd); H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab"; printf "%s" "{\"plugins\":{\"hub\":{\"enabled\":false}}}" > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -s "$R/plugins" "$H/plugins"; cd "$H"; HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/main.py" --no-daemon'

steps.description: app returned to the input prompt

steps.pattern: New Loadout|Edit Loadout|press N to create
